## What problem does this solve?

Describe the useful result and what changes for the user or their agent.

## How to use it

For a new Skill, include the entry point, synthetic inputs, and expected output.
For docs, name the user or contributor path you clarified.

## Validation and limits

List actual commands/results. Distinguish offline tests from live browser evidence.
For docs only, include link and command checks. Note anything not tested.

## Release scope

Which Skill/bundle changes, if any? Does its input, checkpoint, or output contract change?
Keep task data, credentials, and machine-specific settings out of the PR.
